steps.what: Copy held facts into required environmental, building, or other permit applications.
Prepare or assist the permit preparation for those permits.
Mark permit fields that are still empty.

tasks.design: Facts the project already holds are copied into the required environmental, building, or other permit applications in {DOCS}. The manager prepares or assists the rest of the preparation. A fact with no id is not copied. The copy is not a permit decision. Empty fields stay marked until the manager fills them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same project facts were typed again into each permit form.
tasks.enabler_now: Held facts can be copied. The manager still writes the answers the record does not hold.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the application is complete enough to send is the manager's judgement, and the authority decides the permit.
tasks.human_edge: The manager writes the narrative and decides the application is ready. The form does not decide that.
tasks.altitude: Copied fields are only facts already held. The manager prepares everything the form still asks.

reach.task: Prepare a filing for an authority.
reach.learn: A copied field is not the authority's decision.

evidence.claim: Permit fields that match facts the company already holds can be copied. The manager writes the rest.
The permit decision belongs to the authority. A completed company field is not that decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A permit id and a fact id are required before a field is copied. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: A field with no matching fact stays empty. The step does not invent an answer.
Nothing is submitted to the authority from this task.
unknowns: Which permit fields have no matching fact in the project record.
research_questions: Which answers are still written only in the manager's mail to the consultant?

already_counted.description: Preparing the answers the record does not hold stays with the manager.

incremental.description: Check each copied field names the fact it came from.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes few permit fields match a held fact, so the manager prepares the form by hand. High assumes the factual fields copy cleanly and the manager writes only the rest. Nothing is submitted here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare proposals or bids on price and stated exceptions.

loop.purpose: Tie each bid exception to a scope clause id.
loop.input: The exception text and the scope clauses.
loop.output: An exception row with a clause id, or a gap.
loop.check: The clause id is in the scope.
loop.stop: Stop when an exception has no clause id.
loop.why_not_simpler: A price sort cannot tell which scope clause a free-text exception refers to.

steps.what: Review or evaluate proposals and recommend regarding awarding of contracts.
File the recommendations on awarding of contracts.

tasks.design: Proposals or bids are compared in {PROCUREMENT} on price and on stated exceptions, and each exception must cite a scope clause. The manager reviews the proposals and recommends on the awarding of contracts. A bid with no id is not compared. The table does not award the work. {DOCS} files only the recommendation the manager made.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bids were read as separate files, and exceptions were easy to miss.
tasks.enabler_now: Price and exceptions can be lined up, and an exception with no clause id can be stopped.
tasks.still_hard: Who should receive the contract is a judgement about risk, not the lowest price.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recommends the award. A sorted price does not make that recommendation.
tasks.altitude: The recommendation is the manager's. The bid table shows price and clause gaps and stops there.

reach.learn: A price sort is not the award.

evidence.claim: A bid table can line up price and stated exceptions against scope clauses the company holds. It does not choose the winner.
The award recommendation is the manager's decision. A missing clause id is a gap, not a score of the bidder.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A bid id and a scope clause id are required on every exception row. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The table does not rank bidders. It shows price and clause gaps only.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the development manager.
unknowns: Whether exceptions arrive as structured rows or only inside a prose proposal.
research_questions: Which awards are still decided from a printed set with no clause ids?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the proposals and making the recommendation stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check the bid table includes every proposal the manager was asked to review.

approvals.approved_version: recommendation version and the bid ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes exceptions have no clause id, so the manager reads the proposals by hand. High assumes each exception cites a clause and the manager only makes the recommendation. Filing waits for that recommendation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List site assessment and environmental study items still open.
Manage site assessments or environmental studies for the wind fields.
Record what the field visit found against each open study.

tasks.design: Open site assessment and environmental study items are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager manages those assessments and studies on the wind fields. A study with no id is not listed. The list does not decide the study. The manager records what the visit found in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study items were tracked in mail, so a visit could miss one.
tasks.enabler_now: Open items can be listed before the manager goes to the field.
tasks.still_hard: What the ground shows, and whether a study is enough, is judged on the site.
tasks.human_edge: The manager manages the studies and decides what the visit means. The list does not.
tasks.altitude: Site judgement stays in the field. The list only shows which studies are still open.

reach.role: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
reach.task: Manage an environmental study on a site.
reach.learn: An open item is not a finding.

evidence.claim: Open study items can be listed from the project record. The list does not decide an environmental question.
A site assessment is judged on the ground. A desktop list is not that assessment.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A study id is required. A study with no id is not listed as open. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: The field note is written by the manager. The list does not draft a finding.
unknowns: Whether environmental studies are commissioned by this manager or by an outside firm.
research_questions: Which findings are still only in a consultant's report and not on the study item?

already_counted.description: Managing the studies and recording the visit stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check the open-study list is for the field being visited.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes study items have no id, so the manager prepares the visit from the consultant's mail. High assumes the open items are listed. The field judgement is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Index wind project documents already held, with version and date.
Prepare wind project documentation, including diagrams or layouts.
Check the documentation set names every diagram and layout.

tasks.design: Documents the project already holds are indexed from {DOCS} with version and date. The manager prepares the wind project documentation, including the diagrams or layouts that are not in the index. A document with no id is not indexed. The index does not draw a layout. The manager checks the set.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagrams were hard to find because versions lived in personal folders.
tasks.enabler_now: An index can show the versions already held. The manager still prepares the drawings.
tasks.still_hard: A layout is a design judgement. An index of old drawings is not a new layout.
tasks.human_edge: The manager prepares the diagrams and decides that the set is complete.
tasks.altitude: Drawings stay with the manager. The index only shows which versions already exist.

reach.task: Keep a drawing set under version control.
reach.learn: An index entry is not the diagram.

evidence.claim: A document store can index versions and dates the company already holds. It does not draw a layout.
A diagram or layout is prepared by a person. The index only shows what is already filed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A wind development manager in a mid-size European company. A project list does not direct work, award a contract, or decide a permit.
Fields: A document id, a version, and a date are required before a row is indexed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the development manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Diagrams that are not in the index are prepared by the manager, not generated.
unknowns: Whether layouts are drawn by this manager or by a drafter the manager directs.
research_questions: Which diagrams are still only in a local folder and not in the document store?

already_counted.description: Preparing the diagrams and checking the set stay with the manager.

incremental.description: Check the index is for the project whose documentation is being prepared.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes documents have no version id, so the manager hunts for them by hand. High assumes the index is complete and the manager's time is the drawing. The layouts are not generated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The development manager still writes what a permit form does not already hold, still recommends who is awarded the work, and still manages the site studies. Diagrams are drawn by a person. An index can show which versions exist.
reach: Regulatory affairs managers prepare a filing and a person signs it, and this job learns a copied permit field is not the authority's decision.
Compliance managers compare a bid with the scope, and this job learns the comparison is not the award.
skills_to_grow: Tell a copied permit field from an answer the manager still has to write.
Recommend a contract from the bid table without letting a price sort decide.
Keep the site assessment as a field judgement.
role.ambitious_version: A permit application leaves the company only with the manager's text on the fields the record did not hold, and a contract recommendation cites the bid rows the manager used.
